rules: Paid daily targets are hard minimums and must not be silently reduced for expected-profit optimization.
For 2026-08-23, current-day NOTE 5 and BOOTH 5 strict publication are the absolute first production priority because carried debt is zero and both batches are already materialized.
A paid scheduled slot that cannot reach verified publication is not discarded; it becomes paid publication debt.
Paid publication debt survives date changes and PC power-off periods until buyer/reader-visible publication is verified.
Previous-day paid debt must be serviced before treating the current day's paid quota as satisfied.
One run may complete multiple publications when debt exists or today's floor remains; pacing preferences are not production caps.
Do not count queue insertion, local publisher success logs, editor/admin URLs, drafts, commits, old-item reverification, or unverified pages as completed paid publications.
Free note articles, GitHub Pages tools and new paid candidates are secondary until both current-day paid floors are strict verified 5/5.
Cloud-side planning, encryption, queue production and publisher repair continue when Windows is unavailable, but must preserve the current-day 5+5 recovery order.
Do not disable BOOTH/note automation because of a recoverable publication or verification delay.
If one current-day paid candidate remains blocked, defer it briefly and switch to another current-day qualified candidate rather than ending the run or falling back to a legacy blocker.
